title: Transition-Matrix Regularization for Next Dialogue Act Prediction in Counselling Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2604.18539v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies how empirical dialogue-flow statistics can be incorporated into Next Dialogue Act Prediction (NDAP). A KL regularization term is proposed that aligns predicted act distributions with corpus-derived transition patterns. Evaluated on a 60-class German counselling taxonomy using 5-fold cross-validation, this improves macro-F1 by 9--42% relative depending on encoder and substantially improves dialogue-flow alignment. Cross-dataset validation on HOPE suggests that improvements transfer across languages and counselling domains. In systematic ablations across pretrained encoders and architectures, the findings indicate that transition regularization provides consistent gains and disproportionately benefits weaker baseline models. The results suggest that lightweight discourse-flow priors complement pretrained encoders, especially in fine-grained, data-sparse dialogue tasks.

translated_title: 心理咨询对话中下一对话行为预测的转移矩阵正则化方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究如何将经验性的对话流统计信息融入下一对话行为预测（NDAP）任务。文中提出了一种KL正则化项，用于将预测的对话行为分布与从语料库中提取的转移模式对齐。在一个包含60个类别的德语心理咨询分类体系上，采用5折交叉验证进行评估，结果表明该方法根据编码器的不同可使宏观F1相对提升9%至42%，并显著改善了对话流的对齐程度。在HOPE数据集上的跨数据集验证显示，该改进能够跨语言、跨心理咨询领域迁移。通过对多种预训练编码器和架构进行系统性消融实验，研究发现转移正则化能够带来一致的增益，且对较弱的基线模型有格外显著的提升作用。研究结果表明，轻量级的语篇流先验知识可以与预训练编码器形成有效互补，尤其适用于细粒度、数据稀疏的对话任务。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于KL散度的转移矩阵正则化方法，将语料库中的对话流统计先验融入下一对话行为预测，在心理咨询对话任务上使宏观F1相对提升9%至42%，且该改进可跨语言和跨领域迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a KL transition-matrix regularization that incorporates corpus-derived dialogue-flow priors into Next Dialogue Act Prediction, achieving 9–42% relative macro-F1 improvements on counselling conversations with transferability across languages and domains.
